title: Understanding CNN Layers: Convolution, ReLU, Pooling, and Flattening Explained

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to the section on Convolution Neural Networks.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到卷積神經網路章節。

cues.en: Super excited that you are joining us for this section as well.
cues.zh: 很高興你也加入這個章節。

cues.en: And today we're going to cover off the plan of attack, how we're going to learn everything in this section.
cues.zh: 今天先介紹學習計畫，看看要如何學習本章所有內容。

cues.en: There's so much to learn.
cues.zh: 要學的東西很多。

cues.en: Let's see how we're going to approach this.
cues.zh: 來看看我們的學習方式。

cues.en: All right, what we'll learn in this section, first of all, we'll talk about what convolutional networks actually are.
cues.zh: 首先，我們會談談卷積神經網路到底是什麼。

cues.en: Very important to understand the end goal that you're working towards before you actually start working towards it.
cues.zh: 開始之前，先了解最終要達成的目標非常重要。

cues.en: So we'll talk about features, we'll have a look at a few little examples.
cues.zh: 我們會談特徵，並看幾個小例子。

cues.en: We'll compare the human brain to artificial neural networks in terms of image recognition.
cues.zh: 也會比較人腦與人工神經網路如何辨識影像。

cues.en: So it'll be a fun, a light tutorial to get us started for this whole section.
cues.zh: 用一堂輕鬆有趣的教學，開始這整個章節。

cues.en: Then we'll talk about step one, diving straight into it, convolution operation.
cues.zh: 接著直接進入第一步：卷積運算。

cues.en: So this part of the course contains several steps that we need to go through in order to build a convolutional neural network.
cues.zh: 課程這個部分會依建立卷積神經網路所需的步驟來進行。

cues.en: And that's how these tutorials are going to be broken up.
cues.zh: 各堂教學也會依這些步驟劃分。

cues.en: So this one's gonna be step one, the convolution operation.
cues.zh: 所以這堂是第一步，卷積運算。

cues.en: We'll learn everything about feature detectors, we'll talk about which are also filters.
cues.zh: 我們會學習特徵偵測器，也就是濾波器的相關內容。

cues.en: We'll talk about feature maps and what are the different parameters there, what they mean.
cues.zh: 也會談特徵圖、其中有哪些不同參數，以及它們的意義。

cues.en: And we'll have a look at some visual examples as well.
cues.zh: 還會看一些視覺化範例。

cues.en: Then we'll talk about step one part B, the Relu layer or ReLU layer, which is the rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: 接著是第一步的 B 部分，ReLU 層，也就是修正線性單元。

cues.en: And we'll talk about why linearity is not good and how we want more non-linearity in our network for image recognition.
cues.zh: 我們會討論為什麼線性不理想，以及為什麼影像辨識網路需要更多非線性。

cues.en: Then we'll talk about step two, pooling, and we'll understand how pooling works.
cues.zh: 第二步是池化，我們會了解它如何運作。

cues.en: We'll talk specifically about max pooling and we'll also mention a couple of things about mean pulling or sum pooling and other approaches that you can take to the process of pooling.
cues.zh: 主要介紹最大池化，也會簡單提及平均池化、加總池化及其他池化方式。

cues.en: Also in this lecture, we'll have a really cool example.
cues.zh: 這堂課還會有一個很棒的範例。

cues.en: So there'll be a very visual interactive tool that we're going to look at.
cues.zh: 我們會看一個非常直觀的互動工具。

cues.en: So make sure to stick around to the end of that lecture because that's going to add a lot of value to your learning process.
cues.zh: 務必看到該堂課最後，因為那段內容能大幅幫助學習。

cues.en: What we're going to discuss at the end there, step three, flattening.
cues.zh: 到時會在結尾討論。第三步是攤平。

cues.en: So here, it's gonna be a quick tutorial on how to proceed from your pooled layers to your flattened layer.
cues.zh: 這是一堂簡短教學，說明如何從池化後的層，轉成攤平的層。

cues.en: And then we're going to talk about full connection.
cues.zh: 接著討論全連接。

cues.en: So this is the very meaty tutorial that puts everything together and puts everything into perspective and actually shows you how everything works at the end of the day
cues.zh: 這堂內容很充實，會整合所有概念，說明各部分的關係，以及整個流程最後如何運作，

cues.en: and how those final neurons understand how to classify image.
cues.zh: 讓你了解最後的神經元如何判斷影像類別。

cues.en: Very, very important tutorial and hopefully that will summarize or kind of put everything together for you.
cues.zh: 這堂非常重要，希望能幫你統整前面的全部內容。

cues.en: And finally, we'll have a summary, which will summarize everything we've talked about.
cues.zh: 最後會有總結，回顧所有討論過的內容。

cues.en: And as an extra little feature, I've included in a tutorial on softmax and cross entropy.
cues.zh: 另外還加了一堂 Softmax 與交叉熵的補充教學。

cues.en: So you don't have to take this tutorial, but I thought it'd be a great addition of knowledge because these are terms that you will come across when dealing with convolutional neural networks.
cues.zh: 這堂不是必修，但我認為是很好的補充知識，因為處理卷積神經網路時會遇到這些術語。

cues.en: So maybe take it right away.
cues.zh: 你可以直接先看。

cues.en: Maybe when you come across these terms, you will always know, you can come back to this course and take this tutorial to understand better what softmax and cross entropy are.
cues.zh: 也可以等到遇見這些術語時，再回到課程，透過這堂教學深入了解 Softmax 與交叉熵。

cues.en: And also as always, throughout these tutorials, there will be lots of recommended reading for you to further upscale and get more knowledge.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，這些教學也會提供許多延伸閱讀，讓你繼續提升能力、增加知識。

cues.en: And on that note, I can't wait to see you on the first tutorial.
cues.zh: 那麼，迫不及待在第一堂教學與你見面了。

cues.en: This is gonna be a very fun and exciting section.
cues.zh: 這會是個非常有趣又精彩的章節。

cues.en: And until next time, enjoy deep learning.
cues.zh: 下次見，祝你享受深度學習的樂趣。
